    Decisions

    All 38 resolutions of the Student Council, Tha Prachan, from 7 meetings, as printed in the minutes.

    Period
    13 May 2025 to 19 March 2026, academic year 2568 (2025 to 2026)
    Source
    7 sets of minutes (source documents 39, 40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 45)
    Last updated
    31 October 2026
    Next update
    To be announced

    The minutes record vote totals only, not how each member voted. Some appointments are recorded by party, and those party totals are in the CSV file.
